protocol.title: Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and Droplet Digital PCR (ddPCR) Protocol
protocol.source: Clelland Lab Protocols, Weill Institute for Neurosciences, UCSF
protocol.platform: Benchtop PCR (Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler) + Droplet Digital PCR (Bio-Rad QX200 system)
affiliations: Weill Institute for Neurosciences, University of California, San Francisco, USA
Department of Neurology, University of California, San Francisco, CA, USA
protocol.objective: Standard PCR for DNA amplification and gel-based QC, followed by Droplet Digital PCR (ddPCR) for absolute quantification of target copy number relative to a reference gene (RPP30)

forward_primer.resuspension: IDT lyophilised primers resuspended to 100 uM in H2O, then diluted to 10 uM working stock

pcr_for_sequencing.note: Run 50 uL reaction instead of 20 uL

gel_electrophoresis.agarose_example: 2 g agarose + 100 mL 1X TAE buffer for 2% gel
gel_electrophoresis.tae_buffer_1x_preparation: 36 mL 50X TAE Buffer in 2L bottle; add diH2O to 1800 mL

dna_ladder.product: Quick-Load Purple 1 kb Plus DNA Ladder

reference_assay.product: ddPCR Copy Number Assay: RPP30, Human, Homo sapiens

target_probe.ordering: IDT PrimeTime qPCR Probes (5' FAM/ZEN/3' Iowa Black FQ)

generation_oil.note: Single-use; must be used within one day of opening

thermal_cycler.product: C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler with 96-Deep Well Reaction Module

pcr_plate_heat_seal.product: PCR Plate Heat Seal, foil, pierceable

steps.name: Cell washing and QuickExtract DNA extraction

operations.action: Wash cells with 100 uL PBS per well; aspirate
Add 30 uL QuickExtract per well
Scrape well bottom with pipette tip to detach cells
Transfer cells to labelled PCR tubes
Vortex 15 s
Incubate at 65 C for 6 min
Vortex 15 s
Incubate at 98 C for 2 min
Store at -20 C

steps.notes: BioScript: vortex steps abstracted as heat at 25 C for 15 s (no standalone vortex op). PBS wash/aspirate modelled as mix then dispose(pbsWash).

operations.action: Resuspend IDT primers with H2O to 100 uM (e.g. 20 nmol -> add 200 uL H2O)
Dilute to 10 uM working stock (e.g. 20 uL + 180 uL H2O)
Store at -20 C

steps.name: PCR master mix preparation and reaction setup

operations.action: Prepare Master Mix for (number of reactions + 1) as extra
Add 1 uL DNA sample + 19 uL Master Mix per PCR tube
Load into Bio-Rad Thermal Cycler; select/edit PCR protocol

steps.name: PCR thermocycling

cycle_program.name: Annealing
cycle_program.notes: Annealing temperature should be 5-10 C lower than Tm of primers

steps.bioscript_abstraction: One representative cycle encoded at 57 C annealing (midpoint of 50-65 C range); 72 C extension for 60 s (1 min/kb); no loop construct in BioScript

steps.name: Gel electrophoresis and LI-COR imaging QC

gel_preparation.action: Prepare 1X TAE buffer (36 mL 50X TAE + diH2O to 1800 mL)
Prepare 1.5-2% agarose gel (e.g. 2 g agarose + 100 mL 1X TAE for 2%)
Heat in microwave until completely dissolved
Add 15 uL SYBR Safe DNA Gel Stain (per 150 mL gel)
Pour onto tray; remove bubbles; place comb (15 or 20 well)

gel_run.action: Place solidified gel in Bio-Rad Sub-Cell GT Cell; wells at negative (black) terminal
Fill with 1X TAE buffer until gel is submerged
Load ~12 uL DNA ladder (Quick-Load Purple 1 kb Plus) and PCR products
Run at 100-140 V (voltage depends on gel size); Black to Black, Red to Red
Run until bands are resolved (~40 min typical)

imaging.action: Clean LI-COR Odyssey M imager glass with EtOH and Kimwipe
Open LI-COR Acquisition Software; select Scan; Username: Clelland Lab; Imager: Odyssey M; Connect
Select Gel -> Connect; Draw Scan Area -> Next
Select 488 SYBR Safe; Save; Focus offset 2.00 mm; Scan
Clean imager glass again after use

steps.name: Gel extraction (for sequencing, optional)

operations.action: Run gel electrophoresis as above (50 uL reaction)
Excise desired gel band under UV light
Transfer gel slice to 1.5 mL tube
Add 0.6 mL Qiagen Buffer QG
Incubate at 50 C until gel completely dissolved; mix every 1-2 min
Add 100 uL 100% isopropanol; mix by inverting
Transfer to MinElute spin column (stored at 4 C); centrifuge 8000 rpm 1 min; discard filtrate; replace in collection tube
Repeat step 7 until all sample has passed through column
Add 650 uL Buffer PE; centrifuge 8000 rpm 1 min; discard filtrate; replace in collection tube
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm 1 min; discard filtrate and collection tube
Place column in new 1.5 mL tube
Add 35-50 uL Buffer EB to center of membrane
Incubate at 42 C for 3 min
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm 1 min
Repeat steps 12-14 to increase yield (reload DNA product from step 14)

steps.notes: Gel extraction not separately encoded in the primary BioScript file; it is a downstream offline step following a 50 uL PCR reaction.

operations.action: Thaw all components to room temperature
Vortex at full speed for 15 s between each mixing step
Combine primers and probe with H2O as above; mix thoroughly
Store at -20 C; protect FAM probe from light

steps.name: ddPCR master mix preparation and reaction setup

operations.action: Thaw all components to room temperature; vortex 15 s at full speed when mixing
Prepare Master Mix for (number of reactions + 1) as extra
Combine: 11 uL 2X Supermix + 1.1 uL 20X target + 1.1 uL 20X reference + H2O + DNA to 22 uL

steps.name: Droplet generation

operations.action: Insert DG8 Cartridge into cartridge holder
FIRST: load >20 uL sample into sample wells (all 8 wells must be loaded; empty wells: 50:50 Supermix + H2O; no bubbles)
THEN: load 70 uL generation oil into oil wells
Apply DG8 Gasket on cartridge
Load cartridge into QX200 Droplet Generator; START (~1 min)

steps.notes: Generation oil is single-use; can only be used within one day once opened. Transfer droplets within 5 min of generation.

steps.name: Droplet transfer and plate sealing

operations.action: Transfer 40 uL droplets to ddPCR 96-well plate; pipette SLOWLY (>7 s aspiration and dispensing)
Cover plate with foil seal sheet (red line facing up)
Seal in PX1 PCR Plate Sealer at 180 C for 5 s

steps.notes: Transfer must occur within 5 min of droplet generation. Slow pipetting prevents droplet shearing.

steps.name: ddPCR thermocycling
steps.instrument: Bio-Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler with 96-Deep Well block
steps.constraint: Must be run within 40 min of plate sealing

cycle_program.name: Annealing/Extension
cycle_program.notes: Optimise annealing temperature using gradient when using primers/probe for first time

steps.bioscript_abstraction: One representative cycle encoded at 57 C (midpoint of 50-65 C range); 60 s annealing/extension; no loop construct in BioScript

operations.action: Let sealed plate equilibrate at room temperature for 1-2 min (storable at 4 C for up to 3 days before reading)
Place plate in Bio-Rad QX200 Droplet Reader
Open QuantaSoft; select well; configure: Experiment: CNV2; Supermix: ddPCR Supermix for Probes (no dUTP)
Target 1 (FAM): Ch 1 Unknown (enter name); Target 2 (HEX/VIC): Ch 2 Reference (e.g. RPP30)
Copy and paste configuration for every well used; save template; RUN
Data analysis: set threshold manually (pink line); separate positive droplets (blue/green) from negative (grey)

pcr_primers.avoid: more than 3 consecutive G or C repeats; complementary regions within or between primers
pcr_primers.melting_temperature_Tm_C: 50-65; primer pairs within 5 C of each other

ddpcr_probes.position: Between primer pair; no overlapping with primers
ddpcr_probes.composition: More Cs than Gs; no G at 5' end
ddpcr_probes.ordering: IDT PrimeTime qPCR Probes (5' FAM/ZEN/3' Iowa Black FQ)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: QuickExtract DNA extraction; PCR master mix prep; thermocycling; gel electrophoresis; gel QC detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: ddPCR probe prep; ddPCR master mix; droplet generation; plate sealing; thermocycling; droplet readout

bioscript_notes.ir_output: 7 basic blocks (BB1-BB7), 2 if/else gates, 8 CFG edges
bioscript_notes.duration_tokens: s (seconds) and m (minutes) only; h token not supported
abstractions: Vortex steps (15 s) abstracted as heat at 25 C for 15 s (no standalone vortex op in BioScript)
PBS wash/aspirate modelled as mix then dispose(pbsWash); disposed variable never re-referenced
PCR thermocycle loop: one representative cycle at 57 C annealing (midpoint); no loop construct
ddPCR thermocycle loop: one representative cycle at 57 C; no loop construct
Plate sealing at 180 C for 5 s modelled as heat(sealedPlate) after mix with FoilSealSheet
Gel electrophoresis run at 25 C for 40 m abstracts voltage application at ambient temperature
ddPCR DNA input: fresh second dispense/re-extraction block to avoid referencing disposed variable
drain normalises to dispose in IR output per compiler behaviour
